zh.title: 说明
items: **0.0.2-beta.1** 是 0.0.2 系列首个公开 beta，基于 0.0.1 稳定版继续扩展本地 Agent、Automation、Workbench 与终端体验。
本版保持本地能力执行、显式授权与 Evidence 回传边界；对话中的模型文本不能替代真实工具结果或自动化创建收据。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **对话内创建自动化任务**：在聊天中识别周期性工作并展示结构化提案；只有用户确认后才创建 Automation，成功后返回真实创建收据。
**Automation Center**：新增 prompt-first 创建体验、模型辅助识别、生成后的计划编辑、确认弹层，以及运行状态在托盘中的展示。
**Automation 权限预设**：自动化运行继续复用统一的本地权限与工具执行链；只读观察预设不会获得写入能力。
**Workbench 文件体验**：文件页新增创建文件 / 文件夹、刷新和筛选工具栏，并修正离开 Chat 后仍占用布局列的问题。
**模型上下文档位**：Desktop 可为模型选择上下文窗口档位，并将选择接入聊天运行时与上下文预算。
**自动更新**：应用可自动检查更新，并提供升级提示与发布说明。

zh.title: 优化
items: **Chat 输入与任务入口**：侧栏任务入口文案更清晰；会话输入框由 CSS 统一自适应高度，支持更长输入且避免逐字触发布局测量。
**统一布尔控件**：设置、能力详情、Automation 和导入流程统一使用可访问的 Switch / Checkbox，并遵循明暗主题 Token。
**Provider 与模型设置**：改进连接流程、模型目录与刷新结果保留，补充服务图标和上下文窗口配置。
**TUI 流式性能**：为流式更新、Markdown 与语法高亮引入受控刷新和有界缓存，减少长会话中的重复渲染工作。
**TUI 主题一致性**：系统主题变化后，界面配色、主题状态与订阅通知保持同一事实源。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复外部会话重载时上下文用量状态可能残留或显示错误的问题。
修复 Workbench 文件打开、目录刷新与监听调用签名不一致导致的类型错误。
修复 Provider 目录刷新后结果未被保留，以及 Automation 运行状态未正确出现在托盘的问题。
强化 Automation 提案幂等性与身份校验，避免重复确认、旧卡片或跨会话提案重复创建任务。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
资产示例：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
安装方式：
**npm（有 `NPM_TOKEN` 且 publish 成功时）**：`npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`），`postinstall` 自动拉本版归档。
**手动**：解压归档后将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验，再运行 `peer`。
可不装 Desktop；会话与设置仍落在 `~/.peer-agent`，与客户端共享。

en.title: Notes
items: **0.0.2-beta.1** is the first public beta in the 0.0.2 line, extending the local Agent, Automation, Workbench, and terminal experience from the 0.0.1 stable baseline.
Local capability execution, explicit authorization, and Evidence remain the governing boundary. Model text in a conversation cannot stand in for a real tool result or automation creation receipt.

en.title: What's New
items: **Create automations from conversations**: detect recurring work in chat and present a structured proposal. An Automation is created only after explicit confirmation, followed by an authoritative creation receipt.
**Automation Center**: adds prompt-first creation, model-assisted detection, editable generated plans, a governed confirmation overlay, and runtime status in the tray.
**Automation access presets**: scheduled runs continue through the shared local permission and tool-execution chain; observe-only presets do not gain write capabilities.
**Workbench files**: adds create-file, create-folder, refresh, and filter actions, and releases the Workbench layout column when leaving Chat.
**Model context tiers**: Desktop can select a context-window tier per model and carry it into chat runtime budgeting.
**Automatic updates**: the app can check for new releases and show an upgrade prompt with localized release notes.

en.title: Improvements
items: **Chat composer and task entry**: clearer task navigation and CSS-owned textarea sizing for longer prompts without per-character layout measurement.
**Unified boolean controls**: settings, capability details, Automation, and import flows now share accessible Switch / Checkbox components and governed light/dark tokens.
**Provider and model settings**: improves connection flows, model catalog handling, refresh-result preservation, service icons, and context-window configuration.
**TUI streaming performance**: controlled refresh work plus bounded Markdown and syntax-highlight caches reduce repeated rendering in long sessions.
**TUI theme consistency**: system-theme changes now keep the rendered palette, store state, and subscriber notifications aligned.

en.title: Fixes
items: Clear or replace context accounting correctly when an external conversation reload occurs.
Align Workbench file opening, directory refresh, and watcher calls with their canonical interfaces.
Preserve Provider catalog refresh results and surface Automation runtime state in the tray.
Harden Automation proposal identity and idempotency so repeated confirmations, stale cards, or cross-conversation proposals cannot create duplicate tasks.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships a CLI archive under the same tag / version as Desktop.
Asset example: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; **must stay in the same directory**).
Install:
**npm** (when `NPM_TOKEN` is set and publish succeeds): `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`); `postinstall` pulls this version's archive.
**Manual**: unpack, add the directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, then `peer`.
Desktop is optional; sessions and settings still live under `~/.peer-agent` and are shared with the app.
